description: This PHP class 'HolidayDecorator' in the 'OrangeHRM' system wraps around a 'Holiday' entity to provide formatted access to holiday data such as date and length name. It uses a trait for date formatting and is part of the OrangeHRM's Entity Decorator namespace, indicating its role in decorating or extending entity functionality.

classes.name: HolidayDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing formatted access to 'Holiday' entity data within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a 'Holiday' entity.

methods.name: getHoliday
methods.description: Protected method returning the encapsulated 'Holiday' entity.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the holiday date formatted as a string using DateTimeHelperTrait.

methods.name: getLengthName
methods.description: Returns the name of the holiday length from a predefined map, or null if not found.
